f.title: Send important drug information mailings to physicians in the 200.5 format
f.statement: Manufacturers and distributors of drugs who are required to mail important information about drugs to physicians and others responsible for patient care are asked to make such mailings as prescribed by 200.5, so that the mail is distinctive and promptly recognized and read.
f.clause: § 200.5 Mailing of important information about drugs.

f.title: Do not use the distinctive envelopes for ordinary mail
f.statement: Manufacturers and distributors of drugs are asked not to use the distinctive envelopes for ordinary mail.
f.clause: § 200.5 Mailing of important information about drugs.

f.title: Use first class mail and No. 10 white envelopes
f.statement: Important drug information mailings should use first class mail and No. 10 white envelopes.
f.clause: § 200.5(a) Mailing of important information about drugs.

rows.quote:

f.title: Show the sender name and address in the upper left corner of the envelope
f.statement: The name and address of the drug manufacturer or distributor is to appear in the upper left corner of the envelope.
f.clause: § 200.5(b) Mailing of important information about drugs.

rows.quote:
(b) The name and address of the agency or the drug manufacturer or distributor is to appear in the upper left
corner of the envelope.

f.title: Print the envelope statement in a bordered rectangle in the far left third of the envelope
f.statement: The required statement is to appear in the far left third of the envelope front, in the type and size indicated, centered in a rectangular space about 3 inches wide and 2 1/4 inches high with an approximately 3/8-inch-wide border in the indicated color.
f.clause: § 200.5(c) Mailing of important information about drugs.

f.title: Mark significant-hazard mailings "IMPORTANT DRUG WARNING" in red
f.statement: When the information concerns a significant hazard to health, the envelope statement is "IMPORTANT DRUG WARNING", in three lines, all capitals and centered, with "Important" in 36-point Gothic Bold and "Drug" and "Warning" in 36-point Gothic Condensed type; the rectangle border and statement shall be red.

f.title: Mark labeling-change mailings "IMPORTANT PRESCRIBING INFORMATION" in blue
f.statement: When the information concerns important changes in drug package labeling, the envelope statement is "IMPORTANT PRESCRIBING INFORMATION", in three lines, all capitals and centered, with "Important" in 36-point Gothic Bold and "Prescribing" and "Information" in 36-point Gothic Condensed type; the rectangle border and statement shall be blue.

f.title: Mark correction mailings "IMPORTANT CORRECTION OF DRUG INFORMATION" in brown
f.statement: When the information concerns a correction of prescription drug advertising or labeling, the envelope statement is "IMPORTANT CORRECTION OF DRUG INFORMATION", in four lines, all capitals and centered, with "Important" in 36-point Gothic Bold and "Correction", "Of Drug" and "Information" in 36-point Gothic Condensed type; the rectangle border and statement shall be brown.
